{{Top}}
[[File:Engineer_TotG.jpg|thumb|right|170px|An [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] engineer]]
{{Quote|Sentient creatures can believe whatever they want&mdash;but too often they confuse their hopes and dreams with cold, hard reality. I don't have that luxury. As an engineer, I'm only concerned with what works.|[[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]]|<ref name="Slave ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
An '''engineer''' was a person involved in construction, design, or the use of engines or machines.

==Overview==
[[File:Battlefieldengineers-TCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rebel battlefield engineers]]
Military engineers were technology specialists who focused their energy on making repairs in the field. They were often part of a combat unit and were trained to make rapid repairs and adjustments in highly stressful situations&mdash;even while under fire.

Starship engineers were members of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] crew who maintained the ship's systems. In combat, the engineer could reroute power to increase speed or [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], and repair or jury-rig battle-damaged systems.

Other types of engineers included:

*[[Calibration Engineer]]
*[[Chief Systems Engineer]]
*[[Clone engineer]]
*[[Engineer battle droid]]
*[[Combat engineer (Techno Union)/Legends|Skakoan combat engineer]]
*[[Imperial Combat Engineer]]
*Imperial [[Engineering Division]]
**[[Engineering lieutenant]]
**[[Engineering officer/Legends|Engineering officer]]

==Notable engineers==
[[File:Zabrak_engineer.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] engineer]]
[[Bao-Dur]] was a military engineer during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and later a companion of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]].

[[Feno Gamoc]] was a [[Rybet]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a senior engineer aboard the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engineer who designed all kinds of craft, from [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]], and earned the title of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. Another prominent starship engineer was [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], who ran [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] where he designed the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]].

[[Massad Thrumble]] was an engineer, and the Imperial spy [[Lucius Rothingham]] was a former engineer.

Engineering-related groups included the Republic [[Combat Engineer Battalion]] and the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]]. The later of which trained [[Imperial Combat Engineer]]s. Each [[Special missions platoon]] had one [[Engineering squad]].

==Behind the scenes==
The "Tongue-Tied Engineer" was one of the original twenty-four character templates used by the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

The [[Star Wars: Battlefront II#Engineer Class|Engineer class]] is a class of soldiers in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''.
